lines: The Demonic Capital, Tokyo.
A city where once again tonight, there were no stars in the sky, but the world below glittered with the desires of both man and demon.
She was on the subway, headed for Shinminato-ku, the heart of the ever-expanding city of darkness.
Despite being surrounded by shady passengers—hoodlums, thugs, miscreants—she was on her own, with unconcerned eyes.
Hoshino Mitsuki.
She was a Wind Escape user with the nickname, the “Fan Storm Taimanin”.
She was currently tailing a certain man.
His name was Bosluk.
He was an orc slave trader.
The man's fat, ugly body was crammed tightly into his suit, and he was occupying a seating area for four all by himself.
Standing at his sides, naturally, were aggressive-looking bodyguards.
Both vertically and horizontally, they were over twice Bosluk's size, and were daunting all around them by freely showing off their huge frames and vicious expressions.
Perhaps fearing needless trouble, nobody tried to go near him.
Mitsuki was also keeping a low profile, holding her breath and using the passengers as a wall.
They hadn't noticed her tailing them yet.
However―――
Mitsuki
（Ahh, come on!）
A man behind Mitsuki on her left side, who didn't even have anything to do with the mission, was making suspicious movements.
He had been eyeing her for some time, and was reaching a hand out to her.
He was about to touch her ass.
She sensed that intention on the “wind”.
Mitsuki
（Another one's turned up, huh?）
It was a molester. And the third one so far, at that.
Mitsuki
（Why are they doing this one after another?）
She could never forgive a molester.
Ordinarily, she would punish them with all her might, so that they would never think of doing such a thing again.
However, right now she was in the middle of tailing someone. She could not afford to be conspicuous.
Mitsuki
（There's no choice.）
Of course, since there was no choice, she would keep quiet and brave the molester―――As if.
Using her Wind Escape Arts, Mitsuki sensed the intentions of the insolent hand that was reaching out to her body, and, before it could touch her,
Mitsuki
She dealt him a wind attack, no questions asked!
Molester
「Ugh!」
The molester simply fainted, and crumpled down like a puppet with its strings cut.
Naturally, so as not to stand out, she was suppressing his groans and whatnot with wind.
Mitsuki
（Go to sleep, scoundrel.）
With that, she left him lying there on the spot.
There were often drifters sleeping on the floor in this subway anyway, so it wouldn't make much difference if she added one or two more.
There was no sign that the slave trader had become suspicious.
Mitsuki
（Good, I'm all right.）
Feeling a sense of relief, she carried on monitoring him again.
Perhaps because they were understandably afraid of Mitsuki after she had silenced several people that way, there was no longer anyone reaching their hand out to her.
Mitsuki
（It's quieted down at last, huh?）
She was feeling reassured that things were finally going to settle down, when
A molester appeared elsewhere.
A woman who had just gotten on was having her ass groped by the man behind her.
Mitsuki
「Ah!」
Due to the extremely blatant way he was feeling her up, Mitsuki had let her voice out without thinking.
She could see the slave trader and his bodyguards paying attention to her.
Mitsuki
（Uh-oh.）
She hurriedly turned her face away from those people, but even as she did, the molester kept going.
She couldn't help but be more concerned about that than her shadowing mission now.
Woman
The woman was just putting up with it, unable to fight back, like Mitsuki did, or ask anyone for help.
Because of that, the molester was getting carried away, pressing his body closely against her and escalating the act further and further.
Mitsuki
（You're tailing someone right now...... Tailing...... You mustn't stand out...... You mustn't be conspicuous......）
Mitsuki told herself.
She knew that with her head.
But―――
That moment, she made eye contact with the woman.
Woman
She had turned her face away.
Like she was ashamed to have been seen. As if to say that she was at fault for being molested.
The blood rushed to Mitsuki's head.
Mitsuki
「Stop right there!!」
Before she knew it, she was letting out a loud voice.
She couldn't hold back any longer.
She would not tolerate molesters.
While the man was standing there, surprised by her, Mitsuki marched over to him and brought her fan down on his head.
Mitsuki
「You miscreant!!」
It was no ordinary fan. It was her trusty weapon, which served as a club when closed, and a blade when open.
Molester
「Gugahh!!」
Receiving a hard blow to the top of the head, the molester collapsed to the floor in a heap.
Mitsuki
「Are you all right? I'm sorry I didn't help you sooner.」
Mitsuki showed concern for the woman, but
Woman
「What's your problem? Could you not interfere with other people's jobs?」
What came back to her were those totally unexpected words.
Mitsuki
「Eh?」
Woman
「I don't know where you came from, but outsiders should mind their own business.」
Mitsuki
「Eeehhh?!」
Job? Interfere??
What did she mean?
Ignoring the confused Mitsuki, the woman felt around in the collapsed man's pocket, took out his wallet, and then
Woman
「I'll just take my fee...」
She said, and got off at the next station.
Mitsuki
「Eeeeeeehhhhh?!」
Mitsuki didn't know what was what.
The woman had, in fact, been a prostitute, and had been engaging in molester play at her customer's request.
That was something that the inexperienced Mitsuki couldn't have even imagined.
But, more importantly―――
Mitsuki
「Ahhh!」
She had been struck dumb with surprise, but once the train began to move again, she remembered that she was in the middle of tailing someone, and she wasn't supposed to be conspicuous.
She thoughtlessly looked towards her target, trying to see if she was safe.
Bosluk
What was more, she made eye contact with the man himself.
Mitsuki
（Ah, oh no!）
She turned her face away in a panic, but it was already too late.
The slave trader had nodded towards her, and his bodyguards had approached.
Bodyguard
「Oi, you've been focusing on our boss for a while, haven'tcha?」
Bodyguard
「Who're you, bitch?!」
They were asking who she was, but it looked like they had no intention of listening to her answer.
Without even letting her speak, the bodyguards had attacked Mitsuki.
